code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and relative erythrocytosis. There is neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂). Alkaline phosphatase is slightly elevated. These findings may indicate bone marrow dysfunction or infiltration, possible hypoxic stress, and mild cholestasis. Correlation with clinical context and further hematological evaluation are recommended.
